papers.title: UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
papers.summary: UserArena introduces a real-world interactive benchmark with long-horizon shopping trajectories and an evaluation framework, alongside On-Policy Trajectory Distillation to improve simulator fidelity for agentic recommendations.

papers.title: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
papers.summary: DirCast is a streaming video language model that simultaneously directs live esports broadcasts by selecting cameras and generates real-time commentary using only past context.

papers.title: HoloBoxing: A Simple Recipe for Humanoid Boxing with 7 Minutes of Single-GPU Training
papers.summary: HoloBoxing learns humanoid boxing by combining a frozen whole-body controller with a compact planner that predicts body-point targets, using imitation initialization and reinforcement learning to refine interaction behavior with minimal additional training.

papers.title: Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs
papers.summary: Omni-Woodpecker is a training-free framework that reduces cross-modal hallucinations in omni LLMs by identifying modality conflicts and rebalancing hidden representations to suppress misleading priors.

papers.title: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
papers.summary: TARSphere is a robot framework that integrates physics simulation, embodied NPCs, and a frozen multimodal language model to evaluate long-horizon embodied agents across diverse indoor tasks and social conditions.
